Hi AP team — quick clarifications to speed this along:

1) If you choose ACH: please send the remitter company name (as it will appear in the bank trace) and the expected value date so we can reconcile the payment on receipt.

2) If you choose wire: bank fees are the responsibility of the sender unless otherwise agreed. We can provide an invoice addendum showing the gross amount + bank fee if you need it for your ledger.

3) If you choose virtual card: we can accept it and will confirm over email once the transaction settles. Note that some processors add a 1.5–2.5% fee; if this is an issue we can discuss netting options for larger invoices.

To avoid back-and-forth, Ive attached a one-page vendor remit checklist (Redwood_Remit_Instructions_v2.pdf) and a DocuSign link for the W-9/tax docs: https://docusign.example.com/ABC-Redwood-W9. Completing that form will be sufficient for our AP to release the payment. If you prefer a web form instead, we also have a simple vendor remit form here: https://redwoodinference.example.com/docs/vendor-remit-form

If you can confirm the chosen path and the planned payment date by EOD Monday (2026-06-07), well mark this invoice as queued.

Thanks — looping in Laura (Finance) to note the timeline.

Best,
